title: QUIC RFC 9000 IANA Provisional Registration Policy
purpose: Describe the bounded RFC 9000 Section 22.1.1 IANA provisional-registration policy model used to keep registry-process requirements explicit without mixing them into QUIC packet or runtime behavior.
design_summary: The Section 22.1.1 requirements describe IANA registry administration rather than QUIC wire, transport-parameter, frame, packet, or connection-runtime behavior. The implementation therefore keeps the proof surface as a narrow internal policy model that records the common QUIC registry fields, the provisional-request required fields, the provisional-entry required fields, the provisional omission rules, the Expert Review policy reference, the date-update review exception, and the allowed status values. Requirement-home tests prove each policy fact directly against that model so these clauses are traceable without expanding runtime protocol responsibilities.
data_and_state_considerations: The policy model is immutable process metadata. It does not participate in packet parsing, encoding, connection state, endpoint routing, public APIs, interop harness behavior, or generated IANA registry exports.
edge_cases_and_constraints: The provisional request floor requires only Value and Contact; Date is stored on provisional registry entries but is not required in the request.
Specification and Notes are marked as permanent-registration fields that provisional registrations may omit.
Status is constrained to the two RFC 9000 status strings: permanent and provisional.
The S22P1P1-0001 canonical wording is corrected to avoid overconstraining stored provisional entries to only two fields.
risks: This slice proves Section 22.1.1 registry-process metadata only; it does not claim live IANA synchronization, external registry publication, or codepoint allocation workflow automation.
No parser, serializer, encoder, decoder, or runtime hot path is introduced, so fuzz and benchmark evidence are not applicable to this policy-only slice.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This design closes the bounded S22P1P1 provisional-registration policy family while keeping IANA administrative facts separate from transport runtime behavior.
